# stalwart_spam_dnsbl_settings (Data Source)

Configures DNSBL query limits for spam filtering. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `domain_limit` (Number) Maximum number of DNSBL checks for domain names
- `email_limit` (Number) Maximum number of DNSBL checks for E-mail addresses
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `ip_limit` (Number) Maximum number of DNSBL checks for IP addresses
- `url_limit` (Number) Maximum number of DNSBL checks for URLs
